name: scistack-gui
description: Visual pipeline builder for SciStack scientific data processing

scistack.pythonPath.description: Path to the Python interpreter with scistack-gui installed. Leave empty to auto-detect from the Python extension.

scistack.debug.description: Start a debugpy listener in the SciStack server process so VS Code can attach and hit breakpoints inside user functions executed by the DAG Run buttons. Use the 'Attach to scistack-gui server' launch config to connect.

scistack.debugPort.description: Base port for the debugpy listener when scistack.debug is enabled. Each open database gets its own port, counting up from this one: two servers cannot share one listener, and the second would silently start without a debugger.

scistack.startupTimeoutMs.description: Max time (ms) of silence from the server during startup before the extension kills it. Reset whenever a progress notification arrives, so long-but-progressing startups (e.g. projects on network drives) do not falsely time out.

scistack.rpcTimeoutMs.description: Max time (ms) to wait for the server's response to a single request before failing it. A backstop against a lost response wedging the UI forever, not a work limit: long operations report progress through notifications rather than holding a request open. Set to 0 to disable.

scripts.build:all: npm run build && npm run build:webview
